digest.component_or_area: static analysis (CodeQL) — secret-screen and CLI command routing
propositions: CodeQL rule py/clear-text-logging-sensitive-data reports 5 alerts (83–87) that are taint over-approximations, not real credential leaks.
Alerts 86–87 in _seam.py log detector family names (constants from SECRET_PATTERNS) not secret values; SecretFinding carries no value field by design.

Alerts 83–85 in __init__.py print usage errors (unknown command, bad option, surplus args); the --allow-secret-pattern flag is stripped before argv is returned, so the override reason cannot reach the prints.
Regression tests pin the no-secret-in-logs invariant at both forced-write routes (CLI and library) and usage-error paths with synthetic fixtures and negative assertions for secret fragments.
All 5 alerts dismissed via code-scanning API with false-positive justification and per-alert evidence comments; 0 open alerts remain for the rule.
